submitted.rationale: Of the 5 compositions measured, EQE is highest across a broad Sb-rich plateau: Sb 0.6085 gives 0.0083%, 0.699 gives 0.0082% and 0.774 gives 0.0078%. It falls to 0.0062% at Sb 0.556 and to about zero at Sb 0.393. Index 17 (Sb 0.61) has the highest measured value. This fits Sb-rich rutile or trirutile Cr–Sb–O (CrSbO4/CrSb2O6-type) being the photoactive phase.

rejected.reason: Not measured; activity falls off toward Cr-rich compositions, and Cr2O3-dominated films are unlikely to be good photoanodes
